contexts.text: Before Jehovah ().
They stood before Joseph () = the presence of the Celestial of the Spiritual there. To stand before anyone = presence.
They sat before him () = that they were set in order by his presence... Before him = by his presence.
This land of Egypt is before thee () = that the scientifics of the natural mind are under the auspices of the Celestial Internal... Before thee = under its auspices.
Lay it up before Jehovah () = that it is in the Divine presence. AC 8535.
To give into the judges, or before the judges () = according to what is fair.
Before Jehovah () = from the Lord... because before = presence...
(Such a man) thinks that these things are lawful before God, but unlawful before the world.
(This is merely to cause evils) not to appear before the world.
Like an object which is constantly before the sight.
Before the throne of God () = in the presence of the Lord.

Shall be tormented with fire and brimstone before the holy Angels and the Lamb () = the love of self and the world, and the cupidities therefrom... It is said before the Angels and the Lamb, because these loves are contrary to Divine Truths, and to the Lord...
Under Full, see this reference.
I will confess his name before My Father, and before His Angels () = that they will be in Divine Good, and thence in Divine Truth.
Lamps burning with fire before the throne () = Divine Truth united to Divine Good proceeding from the Lord's Divine Love.
To cast before the throne () = to acknowledge that it is from the Lord alone.
They fell down before the Lamb () = acknowledgement from a humble heart.
In the presence of the Lord, and in the presence of the God of Jacob ().
Standing before the throne and before the Lamb () = those who are in the Lord's Kingdom.
